## 0. Setup

```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(patchwork)

loadfonts(device='win')
```

### Helper functions

#### Importing results files

```{r}
#function for pulling all of the filenames
get_filenames = function(rq){
  dir = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/fx/",rq)
  
  #between person
  if(str_detect(rq,'1A')|str_detect(rq,'2A')){

    fnames = tibble(file=list.files(dir)) %>%
      separate(file,c('version','sample','domain','parameter','ct_ver'),sep="-") %>% mutate(across(everything(),~str_remove(.x,'.RData'))) %>%
      mutate(rq = rq)

    return(fnames)
  }
  #within person
  else{
    
    fnames = tibble(file=list.files(dir)) %>%
      separate(file,c('version','sample','parameter','ct_ver','ran_ver'),sep="-") %>%
mutate(across(everything(),~str_remove(.x,'.RData'))) %>%
      mutate(rq = rq)
  
  return(fnames)  
  }
}

#function for actually importing the files
import_fx = function(rq, version, sample,parameter,ct_ver,domain=NULL,ran_ver=NULL){
  
  if(str_detect(rq,'1A')|str_detect(rq,'2A')){
    filestr <- sprintf('../04-results/metaregressions/%s/fx/%s-%s-%s-%s-%s.RData',rq,version,sample,domain,parameter,ct_ver)
  }
  #within-person
  else{
      filestr <- sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/fx/%s-%s-%s-%s-%s.RData",rq,version,sample,parameter,ct_ver,ran_ver)
  }
  load(filestr)
  print(filestr)
  return(fx)
}
```

#### Wrangling + cleaning data

```{r}
basic_tidy = function(data){
  
  data %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x,2))) %>%
    mutate(pstar = case_when(
      p.value >= .05 ~ '',
      p.value < .05 & p.value >= .01 ~ '*',
      p.value < .01 & p.value >= .001 ~ '**',
      p.value < .001 ~ '***'
    )) %>%
    mutate(es_ci= sprintf("%s [%s,%s]",estimate,conf.low,conf.high))
}

clean_names = function(data){
  
  data %>%
    mutate(sample = plyr::mapvalues(sample,c('pairs','dt','pp','cpe','sc'),
                                  c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3',
                                    'Sample 4','Sample 5'))) %>%
    mutate(domain = factor(domain,c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
    mutate(parameter = str_to_title(parameter))
}
```

#### Kables (between-person models)

```{r}
#kable for 1A
bp_kbl = function(d,rq,version){
  
  head=c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3','Sample 4','Sample 5')
  subhead=c('Estimate [95% CI]','SE',"&tau;","I<sup>2</sup>")
  
  #create the header
  hdr <- c(1,rep(length(subhead),length(head)))
  names(hdr) <- c(" ",head)
  col_names = c("Domain",rep(subhead,length(head)))
  ncol = 1+(length(subhead)*length(head))
  
  #make the table
  tab = d %>%
    select(-parameter)%>%
    kable(
      "html"
      ,escape=F
      ,align = c("r", rep("c", ncol))
      ,col.names = col_names
        ) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = F, html_font = "Times") %>%
    add_header_above(hdr)
  
  #add the rownames
    rs <- d %>% 
    group_by(parameter) %>% 
    tally() %>% 
    mutate(end = cumsum(n), start = lag(end) + 1, start = ifelse(is.na(start), 1, start))
  
  #add rownames to the table
    for(i in 1:nrow(rs)){
    tab <- tab %>% 
      kableExtra::group_rows(rs$parameter[i], rs$start[i], rs$end[i])
    }
  
  save_kable(tab, file = sprintf("../04-results/tables/%s/%s-table.html", rq,version))  
    
  return(tab)
  
}

#kable for 2A

  head=c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3','Sample 4','Sample 5')
  subhead=c('Estimate [95% CI]','SE',"&tau;","I<sup>2</sup>")
  
  #create the header
  hdr <- c(1,rep(length(subhead),length(head)))
  names(hdr) <- c(" ",head)
  col_names = c("Term",rep(subhead,length(head)))

  tab = d %>%

      "html"

      ,align = c("r", rep("c", ncol))

        ) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = F, html_font = "Times") %>%
    add_header_above(hdr)
  
  #add the rownames
    rs <- d %>%

    }

  return(tab)
  
}
```

#### Kables (within-person models)

```{r}
#kable for 1 B
wp_kbl = function(d,rq,version,ran_ver){
  
  
  if(ran_ver == 'two_lvl'){
    col_names = c('Sample','Estimate [95% CI]','SE','&tau;<sub>Between</sub>','&tau;<sub>Within</sub>',"I<sup>2</sup><sub>Between</sub>","I<sup>2</sup><sub>Within</sub>","I<sup>2</sup><sub>Total</sub>")
    ncol = length(col_names)
  }
  if(ran_ver == 'crossed'){
    col_names = c('Sample','Estimate [95% CI]','SE','&tau;<sub>Domain</sub>','&tau;<sub>Subject</sub>','&tau;<sub>Residual</sub>')
    ncol= length(col_names)
  }

  tab = d %>%
    select(-parameter)%>%
    kable(
      "html"
      ,escape=F
      ,align = c("r", rep("c", ncol))
      ,col.names = col_names
        ) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = F, html_font = "Times")
  
    #add the rownames
    rs <- d %>% 
    group_by(parameter) %>% 
    tally() %>% 
    mutate(end = cumsum(n), start = lag(end) + 1, start = ifelse(is.na(start), 1, start))
  
    #add rownames to the table
    for(i in 1:nrow(rs)){
    tab <- tab %>% 
      kableExtra::group_rows(rs$parameter[i], rs$start[i], rs$end[i])
    }
  
  save_kable(tab, file = sprintf("../04-results/tables/%s/%s-%s-table.html", rq,version,ran_ver))  
    
  return(tab)
    
}

#kable for 2B
```

## 02. Tables

### Between person models

#### RQ1A. Between-person heterogeneity

##### Wrangle data

```{r}
bp1 = bp.names1 %>%
  select(-ct_ver) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  arrange(version,parameter,sample,domain) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(fx,basic_tidy)) %>%
  select(-fx) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(tidy, ~.x %>%
                      select(es_ci,std.error,tau2,i2))) %>%
  unnest(cols=c(tidy)) %>%
  mutate(tau2=round(sqrt(tau2),2)) %>%
  rename(tau = tau2) %>%
  group_by(rq,version) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(data = map(data, ~.x %>%
                      pivot_wider(names_from=sample
                                  ,values_from=c(es_ci,std.error,tau,i2)
                                  ,names_vary = 'slowest'
                                  
                                  ) %>%
                      select(parameter,domain,everything()) %>%
                      mutate(across(-domain,~ifelse(is.na(.x),'--',.x)))
                    ))
```

##### Export kables

```{r}
bp1%>%
  mutate(send=pmap(list(data,rq,version),bp_kbl))
```

#### RQ2A. Between person x central trait

##### Wrangle the data

```{r}
bp2 = bp.names2 %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  arrange(version,parameter,sample,domain) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(fx,basic_tidy)) %>%
  select(-fx) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(tidy, ~.x %>%
                      mutate(es_ci = paste0(es_ci,pstar)) %>%
                      mutate(term = case_when(
                        term == 'intercept' ~ 'Intercept',
                        term == 'is_central' ~ 'Central',
                        term == 'ct_high' ~ 'Central (high)',
                        term == 'ct_low' ~ 'Central (low)'
                      )) %>%
                      mutate(tau = round(sqrt(tau2),2)) %>%
                      select(term,es_ci,std.error,tau,i2) %>%
                      mutate(tau = ifelse(term == 'Intercept',tau,''),
                             i2 = ifelse(term=='Intercept',i2,''))
         )
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols=c(tidy)) %>%
  group_by(rq,version,parameter,ct_ver) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(data = map(data, ~.x %>% 
                      pivot_wider(names_from=sample,
                                              values_from=c(es_ci,std.error,tau,i2),
                                              names_vary='slowest'
                                              ) %>%
                      mutate(across(-domain,~ifelse(is.na(.x),'--',.x)))
                    ))
```

##### Export kables - primary analyses

```{r}
bp2 %>%
  mutate(send = pmap(list(data,rq,version,parameter,ct_ver),bp_kbl2))
```

### Within-person models

#### RQ1B. Within-person heterogeneity

##### Wrangle data

```{r}
wp1 = wp.names1 %>%
  mutate(sample = plyr::mapvalues(sample,c('pairs','dt','pp','cpe','sc'),
                                  c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3',
                                    'Sample 4','Sample 5'))) %>%
  mutate(parameter = str_to_title(parameter)) %>%
  arrange(version,parameter,sample) %>%
  mutate(tidy=map(fx,basic_tidy)) %>%
  select(-fx) %>%
  mutate(tidy=map(tidy, ~.x %>% select(es_ci,std.error,contains('sig'),contains('i2'))))
```

##### Export kable – primary models

```{r}
wp1_primary = wp1 %>%
  filter(ran_ver=='two_lvl') %>%
  unnest(cols=c(tidy)) %>%
  select(parameter,sample,everything()) %>%
  select(-i2_lvl1) %>%
  rename(I2_within=i2_lvl2, I2_between=i2_lvl3, I2_total=i2_total) %>%
  mutate(across(contains('sig'),sqrt)) %>%
  mutate(across(contains('sig'),~round(.x,2))) %>%
  select(rq,version,ct_ver,ran_ver,parameter,sample,es_ci,std.error,contains('sig'),I2_between,I2_within,I2_total) %>%
  group_by(rq,version,ct_ver,ran_ver) %>%
  nest() 

wp1_primary %>%
  mutate(send=pmap(list(data,rq,version,ran_ver),wp_kbl))
```

##### Export kable - Supplement F: alternative random effect structure

```{r}
wp1_crossed = wp1 %>%
  filter(ran_ver=='crossed') %>%
  unnest(cols=c(tidy)) %>%
  mutate(across(contains('sig'),sqrt)) %>%
  mutate(across(contains('sig'),~round(.x,2))) %>%
  select(parameter,sample,everything()) %>%
  group_by(rq,version,ct_ver,ran_ver) %>%
  nest() 

wp1_crossed %>%
  mutate(send=pmap(list(data,rq,version,ran_ver),wp_kbl))
```

#### RQ2B. Within-person heterogeneity x central traits

##### Wrangle the data

```{r}
wp2 = wp.names2 %>%
      mutate(sample = plyr::mapvalues(sample,c('pairs','dt','pp','cpe','sc'),
                                  c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3',
                                    'Sample 4','Sample 5'))) %>%
  mutate(parameter = str_to_title(parameter)) %>%
  arrange(version,parameter,sample) %>%
  mutate(tidy=map(fx,basic_tidy)) %>%
  select(-fx) %>%
    mutate(tidy = map(tidy, ~.x %>%
                      mutate(es_ci = paste0(es_ci,pstar)) %>%
                      mutate(term = case_when(
                        term == 'intercept' ~ 'Intercept',
                        term == 'is_central' ~ 'Central',
                        term == 'ct_high' ~ 'Central (high)',
                        term == 'ct_low' ~ 'Central (low)'
                      )) %>%
                      mutate(across(contains('sig'),~round(sqrt(.x),2))) %>%
                      mutate(across(contains('sig'),~ifelse(term=='Intercept',.x,''))) %>%
                      mutate(across(contains('i2'),~ifelse(term=='Intercept',.x,''))) %>%
                      select(term,es_ci,std.error,contains('sig'),contains('i2'))

         )
    )
```

##### Export kables - primary analyses

```{r}
wp2_primary = wp2 %>%

  rename(I2_within=i2_lvl2, I2_between=i2_lvl3, I2_total=i2_total) %>%
  select(rq,version,parameter,ct_ver,ran_ver,sample,term,es_ci,std.error,contains('sig'),I2_between,I2_within,I2_total) %>%
  group_by(rq,version,parameter,ct_ver,ran_ver) %>%
  nest()

wp2_primary %>%
  mutate(send = pmap(list(data,rq,version,parameter,ct_ver,ran_ver),wp_kbl2))
```

## 04. Figures

```{r include=FALSE}
attr0 = read_csv("../02-data/02-clean-data/all-univ-and-traits-merged-CLEAN.csv") %>%
  drop_na()
```

### Figure helper functions + theme

```{r}
my_theme2 <- function(){
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom"
      , legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1))
      , legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = rel(1))
      , axis.text = element_text(size = rel(1.1), color = "#262626",family='Times New Roman')
      , axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2),family='Times New Roman')
      , plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2), hjust = .5,family='Times New Roman')
      , plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = rel(1.2), hjust = .5)
      , strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.1), color = "black",family='Times New Roman')
      , strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",colour='black',size=rel(1.2))
    )
}

b5_pal = c('EXT' = '#F07F09',
           'AGR'= '#9F2936',
           'CON'= '#1B587C',
           'NEU'= '#604878',
           'OPE'='#33CAFF')
```

### RQ1. Heterogeneity in attractor location and strength

```{r include=FALSE}
attr_clean = read_csv("../02-data/02-clean-data/all-univ-and-traits-merged-CLEAN.csv")

clean_ids = attr_clean %>%
  select(sample,SID,domain) %>%
  unique()

attr0 = read_csv("../02-data/02-clean-data/all-univ-and-traits-merged.csv") %>%
  inner_join(clean_ids)

```

#### Between-person results

```{r}
for_traj0 = attr0 %>%
  select(sample,SID,domain,parameter,mean) %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c('mu_x','beta_x')) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=parameter,values_from=mean) %>%
  mutate(domain = factor(domain,levels=c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
  mutate(sample = plyr::mapvalues(sample,c('pairs','dt','pp','cpe','sc'),c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3','Sample 4','Sample 5')))

traj = for_traj0%>%
  crossing(
    p_value = seq(-5,5, .5)
  ) %>%
  filter(mu_x <10) %>%
  mutate(dp = location + mu_x*p_value) 
```

```{r}
traj_plot = traj %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = p_value, y = dp,colour=domain)) + 
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = 0)
    , linetype = "dashed"
  ) + 
  geom_line(
    aes(group = SID)
    # ,colour=domain
    , linewidth = .25
    , alpha = .5
  ) +
  # ylim(-10,10) +
  facet_grid(vars(sample),vars(domain)) +
  my_theme2() +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  scale_colour_manual(values = b5_pal) +
  labs(x='Level of personality state',y='Change in personality state')
```

#### Within-person spaghetti plots

```{r}
spag_plot = function(d,parameter){
  
  d %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=domain,y=mean,group=SID)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour=SID),size=1, position=position_dodge(width=0.1)) +
    geom_line(aes(colour=SID),linewidth=.1, alpha=0.5, position=position_dodge(width=0.1)) +
      my_theme2() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~sample,nrow=1)  +
    labs(title=sprintf('Attractor %s', parameter),y='Estimate',x='Domain')
  
}
```


### RQ2. Central traits

#### Between-person results

##### Prep data

```{r}
bp2_forplot = bp.names2 %>%
  filter(version == 'chill' &ct_ver == 'primary') %>%
  unnest(cols=c(fx)) %>%
  filter(term=='is_central') %>%
  select(sample,domain,parameter,estimate,conf.high,conf.low) %>%
  rename(ci_l=conf.low,ci_u=conf.high) %>%
    mutate(sample = plyr::mapvalues(sample,c('pairs','dt','pp','cpe','sc'),c('Sample 1','Sample 2','Sample 3','Sample 4','Sample 5'))) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, c('Sample 5','Sample 4','Sample 3','Sample 2','Sample 1'))) %>%
  mutate(domain = factor(domain, c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
  arrange(sample,domain) %>%
  mutate(parameter=str_to_title(parameter))
```

Function for forest plot

```{r}
plot_2A = function(d,parameter){
  d %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=sample,y=estimate,colour=domain)) +
  geom_point(stat='identity') +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_l, ymax = ci_u)) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = 0)
    , linetype = "dashed"
  ) + 
  facet_wrap(~domain,nrow=1) +
  my_theme2() +
  scale_colour_manual(values=b5_pal) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title=sprintf('Attractor %s', parameter),y='Estimate',x='Sample')
}
```

```{r}
plots_2a = bp2_forplot %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(plot = pmap(list(data,parameter),plot_2A))

loc_2A = plots_2a$plot[[1]]
str_2A = plots_2a$plot[[2]]

pl = loc_2A / str_2A + plot_layout(axes='collect')
```
